content: Warmi indi­sina puncha katanga churariska i amarun kuku­manda

Chi­ura­mandaka, sug ajai iapa atun siñalmi awapi kawa­ri­wag­samurka. Chi­pika, sug warmi indi­sina pun­cha katanga chu­ra­riska, killa awa­lla­mi saia­kurka. Paipa uma­pika, chunga iskai istri­lla­iug llaug­tu­sina­mi muiu­chi­raiarka.
Chi warmika, wam­britu­wa ungu­rin­ga­pa­mi karka. Ajai­mi kapa­ri­kurka, nanai api­kug­manda.
Sug siñalpasmi awapi kawa­rig­samurka: sug nina puka­sina ajai atun amarun kuku, kan­chis uma­iug i chunga kachu­iug. Tukui kan­chis umapi, sug sug llaug­tu­sina­mi chura­raiarka.

Chi amarun kukuka, awapi tiaska istri­lla­kuna kimsama parti­riska kas­ka­kuna­taka sug par­tita paipa chupa­wa alius­pa­mi kai alpama bula­chi­murka. Chi ama­run kukuka, chi ungug warmipa ñugpa ladumi saia­rig­samurka, wawa tiag­samug­lla­pi, mikun­ga­pa.

Chi warmika, kari wam­brami iukag­samurka. Chi wam­bra ni­ra­iar­kami tukui alpa­manda runa­kunata iru bara­wa iapa man­dag kan­ga­pa. Chi wawa­taka tia­kug Taita Dius­pa man­dag tia­ri­di­ru­ma­mi apar­ka­kuna.
Chi war­mika, Taita Dius agllaska chusa sitaska alpa luar­ma­mi miti­kurka; chi­pika, waranga iskai patsa sugta chunga pun­cha pai­taka mikui kara­kun­ga­pa.
Chi­ura­mandaka, sug luarpi maka­na­kuimi tiarka. Atun anjil, Miguel suti, paipa anjil­kuna­wa, ama­run kuku i ama­runpa anjil­kuna­wa­pas­mi maka­na­kurka. Chi ama­runka, paipa anjil­kuna­wan­ta
mana pudir­ka­kuna­chu bin­sin­ga­pa. Chasaka, mana mas pudir­ka­kuna­chu, sug luarpi kaug­san­ga­pa.

Cha­sa­pika, chi iapa atun ama­run kuku, kai alpa­ma­mi sitamui tukurka. Chi ama­runka ni­raian­mi unai ñugpa­manda kuku kulibra, tukui kai alpa­manda runa­kunata llu­lla­chig, Diablu u Satanás suti iaia kuku. Paita i tukui paipa anjil­kuna­wan­ta­mi kai alpama sitamui tukur­ka­kuna.
Chi­uraka, suma luarpi, kasa­mi sin­chi kapa­rii uia­ri­warka:

content.text: Nukan­chipa Taita Dius­pa suma mandai pun­cha
nukan­chipa Taita Dius­pa ñawipi pai­kunata jucha­chi­dur karka.
paipa Ubija suti wañu­chii tukuskapa iawar­wa­mi
Chasa­manda, suma luar­manda kag­kuna i tukui chipi kaug­sag­kuna­pas,
iapa llakii alpapi i lamar iakupi tukui kaug­sag­kuna­manda!
Chimandami asku­rinti achka rabia­wa kam­kuna­pagma urai­ku­murka.

content: Chi ama­run kukuka, alpama sitamui tukuska kagta kawa­ris­paka, chi kari wam­bra iukaska warmita kalpa­chin­ga­pa­mi kalla­rirka.

Chi warmi­taka atun agi­lapa iskandi alas­kuna­ta­mi chu­ra­chir­ka­kuna; chi­wanka bulaspa, ama­run kukuta sakispa, miti­kun­ga­pa; pai­manda agllaska chusa sitaska alpa luar­pika kimsa wata sugta killa mikui chas­kispa kaug­sa­kun­ga­pa.
Ama­run kukuka, paipa simi­manda atun iaku­mi kim­narka; chi­wanka, chi warmi apai tukun­ga­pa.
Alpaka, war­mita kis­pi­chin­ga­paka, simi pas­ka­rig­sina tukug­samuspa, chi ama­runpa simi­manda kimn­aska iakuta amu­llispa upiarka.

Chasa­manda ama­runka, chi warmi­manda asku­rinti rabia­rispa, rirka, war­mipa sug wam­bra­kunata makan­ga­pa. Chi wam­bra­kunaka ni­raian­kunami Taita Dius ima nis­ka­kunata ruraspa i Jesús ima willas­kata suma cha­ri­rispa kaug­sag­kuna.
Ama­run, lamar iaku patapi ris­paka, saia­rig­rirka.
